title: World Models, Trees and Foundation Models for Retail Forecasting: Evidence from Four Public Data Sets
abstract: arXiv:2610.25170v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A retailer makes different decisions at different grains of the product, store and time hierarchy: store orders for an item in a store, supplier funding for an item across stores, category performance by store, and the financial plan for the chain. Which forecasting model to use depends on the grain. This paper compares models at each grain on four public data sets (M5, six Dominick's categories, Breakfast at the Frat, and Corporaci\'on Favorita, the last kept out of all development), over rolling forecast origins with paired tests and model confidence sets. It covers price and promotion through the plan inputs these data record, not product, assortment or place. translated_title: 世界模型、树模型与基础模型在零售预测中的应用：来自四个公开数据集的证据
translated_abstract: 零售商在产品、门店与时间层级的不同粒度上做出不同的决策：单品在单店的门店订货、单品跨门店的供应商资金投入、按门店衡量的品类绩效，以及整个连锁企业的财务规划。使用哪种预测模型取决于决策粒度。本文在四个公开数据集（M5、Dominick's 的六个品类、Breakfast at the Frat，以及 Corporación Favorita——后者在全部开发过程中被保留不参与）上，通过滚动预测起点、配对检验与模型置信集，对各粒度下的模型进行了比较。研究通过这些数据记录的计划输入来涵盖价格与促销因素，而不涉及产品、商品组合或渠道。所比较的模型包括：一个在价格与促销计划下推进每个商品状态的世界模型、去除该状态的同一网络、LightGBM、Temporal Fusion Transformer、TimesFM、Chronos-Bolt、Timestral、季节性朴素预测，以及各模型预测的等权平均……
tldr: 本文提出了一种在价格与促销计划下推进商品状态的世界模型，并在四个公开零售数据集上针对从单品单店订货到全链财务规划的不同决策粒度，系统比较了它与LightGBM、Transformer及TimesFM等时序基础模型的预测表现，借助配对检验与模型置信集确定各粒度下的最优模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a world model that carries each item's state forward under price and promotion plans, and benchmarks it against LightGBM, Transformers, and time-series foundation models such as TimesFM across different retail decision grains on four public datasets, using paired tests and model confidence sets to identify the best model at each grain.
